name: stack-e2e
// targets: The target is deliberately not called `e2e`: the CI `e2e` job runs `nx run-many -t e2e`, which would sweep this project up and run it against a stack nobody started. For the same reason nx.json excludes this project from the @nx/playwright plugin, which would otherwise infer an `e2e` target from the config file. No `dependsOn` either — the containers are brought up by tools/shipped-stack/verify.sh, not by Nx.
